card.name: Punctuation inside heart failure symptom lists
card.fires_on: Commas, "e.g.," punctuation and "or" inside lists of heart failure symptoms such as weight gain, edema and shortness of breath. Seen mainly in thiazolidinedione (pioglitazone) warnings.

modes.label: Comma after a symptom
modes.description: A comma or "or" right after weight gain or edema in a list of heart failure signs.
modes.example: signs or symptoms of heart failure, such as weight gain, dependent edema<<,>> or increasing shortness of breath.

modes.description: The comma after "e.g." that opens a list of heart failure signs to monitor.
